about: Real teaching sessions by a project team member, Derivatives topic, 2026-11-17/18, exported from a local throwaway database. Identities removed. Sessions marked pipWrittenOnDevice used the on-device model for Pip's replies (now an experiment); the rest used the server pipeline before the assessor/note-taker split.
